name: Stair Climbing at Easy Pace

instructions.description: Stand near the handrail and face the stairs.
Climb at a steady pace, placing the whole foot when possible.
Use the rail lightly and keep breathing controlled.
Descend carefully or use an alternative route if descent is unsuitable.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the time performed with comfortable, controlled technique.
Record the individual's perceived effort after the exercise.

commentsNotes: Use the handrail and a steady pace.

variations.variationDescription: Stair Climbing at Easy Pace — Tempo-Controlled Version: Use a deliberately slower lowering phase without creating a separate database record.
Stair Climbing at Easy Pace — Reduced-Range Version: Use a smaller comfortable range while preserving the same movement pattern.
